argv:
echo "=MYSQL_SOCKET="; mysql --protocol=socket -e "select version()" 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=MYCNF="; ls -la "$HOME/.my.cnf" 2>&1 | head -2
echo "=PHP83="; /opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php -v 2>&1 | head -1
echo "=PHP83EXT="; /opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php -m 2>/dev/null | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "=MK="; mkdir -p "$HOME/bin" && echo ok
echo "=CURL="; curl -sS --max-time 20 -o "$HOME/bin/composer.phar" https://getcomposer.org/composer.phar && ls -l "$HOME/bin/composer.phar"
echo "=VER="; /opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php "$HOME/bin/composer.phar" --version 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=DONE="
